notes.title: Motor Strike: Racing Rampage Patch notes EA-0.0.2a
notes.notes:
During the last weeks we have been working to improve the usability and provide full input support including mouse support and Keyboard and Controller support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/697f3a99c6b2f855ad1141da042fac909f492bf5.png[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full mouse interaction support for all the menus
[*] Full input customization for controllers
[*] Updated Feedback system to reflect the custom keys
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/d3ef83e1d154a598eac3599b24cac2ecb5637cef.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased duration of races (More laps or points)
[*] In point race decreased rewards from checkpoints
[*] In point race increased rewards for Killing enemies and minions 
[*] Increased Illumination in some scenarios
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/14cf67d0343967dfe51c790db399fa2491b0cc14.png[/img]

notes.title: Motor Strike: Racing Rampage Patch notes EA-0.0.1a
notes.notes:
During the last days we have been releasing small patches, this is the this of improvements and changes for the version EA-0.0.1a

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/eba95947e903b992d100f9e4430349422f9120fe.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now The Nitro/turbo gets accumulated as expected
[*] Now you don't loose speed when colliding with other cars (after fix you might lose up to 50% of your speed)
[*] Apply changes button is now localized
[*] The "back" button is correct showed instead of the "next" button in some help menus.
[*] Move heavy loading (Shader warmup) from race loading to initial loading, also divvied in 5 steps so the computer don't show a "not responding" message. (The long loading time might be associated with outdated graphics drivers)
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved AI behavior in Mystic Desert and Vigilant Tower tracks (Now they stay in the track much better) we still checking the AI, besides this in the TODO list is a full adjustment of both, AI and Players car to make it more interesting.
[*] Added an effect when deflecting a missile with the shield
[*] Included better build ID in the scenes
[*] Included "space" character as a valid input in report tool
[*] Included a help text showed when out of tracks reminding you to use the hook in order to return to the race.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/d18da482ea9bc3a6cf046d81c17bface6aa77e51.jpg[/img]


[h2]Visual Improvement[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated terrain from multiple terrains to avoid track/terrain overlapping
[*] Adjusted position of all Turbo zones to be better aligned with track (avoid floating turbo zones)
[*] Reduces some texts of the HUD to make them less intrusive.
[*] Updated Goal Model To make it more visible 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/7dfa921d53b6513b6f1b72a5f0deaebbdfe3cae9.png[/img]

[h2]Balance adjustment:[/h2]
[list]
[*] When out of tracks reduced the distance when is activated by 25%, and timeout reduced from 2.5 to 1.9.
[*] Increasing Damage and speed of laser cannon
[*] Increased Damage and speed of heavy machine gun
[*] Increased Damage and speed of plasma cannon
[*] Reduced damage of missile strike of Ethan, Agent England
[*] Increased 60% cooldown of shield
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/53cb68aa9d537849f84ea384b909e15dbbf9a229.png[/img]

notes.title: Motor Strike: Racing Rampage is now available!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]About the game[/b][/h3]
A demented shooting racing game in which you can play alone or with your friends in the 4-split screen mode, or with up to 8 crazy racers in the online mode. 

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/777460/Motor_Strike_Racing_Rampage][b]Check the store page![/b]
[/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/b0a4f51b66d8c65efe463672bd78e4a83cf36f7e.png[/img]

[h3][b]About the EA[/b][/h3]
During Early Access you’ll have access to a [u]full racing game[/u]. Choose one of the 14 different vehicles, 7 heavy weapons and a lot of skills and be ready to defeat your enemies in more than 20 different tracks.


[b]Motor Strike: Racing Rampage[/b] is being released in Early Access and it will remain like that for 6 months. The final version will include a new battle arena mode, challenge mode and a campaign mode as well as more weapons and cars and tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/6f26900734d133d796796e63f5a6759a76c4b83e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Features (During EA)[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] More than 20 tracks in six types of circuits!
[*] 14 insane vehicles with unique style and skills.
[*] Your race, your rules, many different game modes, and race directives!
[*] 7 different artillery weapons to combat your friends and enemies.
[*] New gameplay mechanics like the Strike Back or the Rolling Strike!
[*] Local Mode with split screen and online up to 8 players
[*] [i][b]Note:[/b] Multiplayer is intended as a tool to mainly play with friends[/i]
[/list]

[h3][b]Early Access Short-term Roadmap:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Check and finish the Tutorials (They are outdated)
[*] Improve and correct the localization for the already supported languages (English, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese)
[*] Improve input management: Rebinding for controllers and Keyboard
[*] Audio improvements and gameplay balance
[*] Activate Dexterities progression
[*] General bug fixing and performance optimization
[/list]

[h3][b]Early access Mid-term Roadmap:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Campaign Mode
[*] Challenge Mode
[*] Battle Mode
[*] Better game balance and AI
[*] New Cars
[*] New Scenes
[*] Steam additional features
[*] New weapons
[*] More...
[/list]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/777460/Motor_Strike_Racing_Rampage][b]Check the store page![/b]
[/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/633b0158a19289f825d8eeece6d5255e5f94b2d2.png[/img]

notes.title: Motor Strike: Racing Rampage Early Access Release on January the 27th
notes.notes:
[b]Motor Strike: Racing Rampage will be released on January the 27th[/b]. During the first months it will be released as an Early access (EA) at a significantly reduced price. The game is fully playable in the race mode, including split screen/multiplayer. (Note: Multiplayer is intended as a tool to mainly play with friends).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/d8c27e76425508b3af154ecaccfef7c0dabdeeaa.png[/img]

[h2][b]About the Early Access:[/b][/h2]
Besides general improvements for the game and increased content, we are adding new features into the EA including a battle mode, a campaign mode and a challenge mode. All of this taking into consideration the players feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/29b19b64172f8c813218a151cfe76917e3bf2e90.png[/img]

To ensure a streamlined feedback process, beyond having a Discord, email (feedback@motorstrike.com) and the Steam community channels, we have integrated a Feedback tool in the game to allow instant direct reporting of any problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/609e1686c962e75ae1a4e4a2e66cf134cfd05e55.png[/img]

[h2]Early Access Short-term Roadmap:[/h2]
Check and finish the Tutorials (They are outdated)
Improve and correct the localization for the already supported languages (English, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese)
Improve input management: Rebinding for controllers and Keyboard
Audio improvements and gameplay balance
Activate Dexterities progression
General bug fixing and performance optimization

[h2]Early access Long-term Roadmap:[/h2]
Campaign Mode
Challenge Mode
Battle Mode
Better game balance and AI
New Cars
New Scenes
Steam additional features
New weapons
More...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/6a5c110679d0b3f427fea4d248408cee8a654386.png[/img]

This Steam Early Access game is currently not a finished game and may or may not change significantly over the course of development. To learn more about Steam Early Access, please visit [url=http://store.steampowered.com/earlyaccessfaq/]http://store.steampowered.com/earlyaccessfaq/[/url]

notes.title: Motor Strike: Racing Rampage avalaible to play
notes.notes:
Hit the pedal and burn the trigger, because now is your turn  to race and fight in this crazy races were not the best but the toughest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/b30c0d9681a204be42283d37e16e2a8c431741bd.png[/img]

Motor Strike: Racing Rampage is the evolution of Motor Strike Immortal Legends and is focused in crazy races full of bullets missiles, explosions and tons of speed!

We are fully reworking all the title from the bottom, right now all the visual have been revised and the gameplay is much streamlined to offer a fast paced experience also we are working in adding new game modes in which the new mechanics can shine even more

Moreover we are doing a new AI and working on a better solution for the physics including new drifting mechanics and behaviors .

We have release a Discord server for support or consulting, for the moment the intention is to keep it up during the Steam Game Festival but if it works we may keep it to gather feedback.

[url=https://discord.gg/TCkYRuh]Motor Strike Discord[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/777460/discussions/]Steam Community[/url]

To see what we can offer simply visit the Steam Webpage and download the demo, and remember to Wishlist's if you like it!

NOTE: Right now we are working on the project so you my find some unbalanced scenarios or minor bugs, we are doing our best to offer the cleanest experience possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879183/e61fb3819e1790143349c0bbd387e84758948bf5.png[/img]
